text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position and roadmap in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis control","description":"The essay states a definite stance early and previews the main reasons it will develop."},{"evidence":"paragraphs that present cost, safety, and convenience in sequence","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into a more coherent body structure that is easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“If the technology fails and someone is injured, people wonder who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges an objection and addresses it directly rather than only asserting its own side."},{"evidence":"“driver’s seats that vibrate… flashing lights… cameras to watch that drivers remain focused”","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay uses multiple concrete details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"“worth the wait and should be developed and created for the future to see”","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending restates the position and brings the argument to a more complete close."}]}
